Priya: LAN Friday indie co-op night? Thinking 8pm at office. Also quick poll: vanilla runs only or mod-friendly? My vote: 2 mods max per game + no save edits. Thoughts?
Sam: Yes for 8pm. I can bring extra PS4 controllers and a Switch dock. :thumbsup:
Jorge: Mod-friendly pls — Celeste mods are fun. But agree on no save tinkering mid-night.
Zoe: @Priya 2 mods cap sounds fair. Also can we have a 'no-hostile-mods' rule? (no instant-win stuff).
Dan: I'll bring a power strip + router (ethernet). Can someone bring an HDMI switch? I have 2 TVs already.
Priya: Awesome — adding checklist: power strip (Dan), router (Dan), HDMI switch (??), spare controllers (Sam), spare joycons? @Maya?
Maya: I have spare joycons and a USB-C charging hub. Also, can we set a quick slot for 'indie draft' — pick 3 indie co-op games by 6pm and vote? keeps variety.
Sam: Love that. My picks: Overcooked 2, Moving Out, Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime.
Jorge: My picks: Celeste co-op mod (not a fan of randomizer), Deep Rock Galactic (if anyone has the PC build), Don't Starve Together.
Zoe: I'll admin the poll. Post your 3 picks here by 6pm, I'll tally and announce. Also PLEASE label controllers and bring sanitizing wipes :nurse:
Ops-bot: Reminder: Office kitchen closes at 9pm. Please respect building access rules. :robot_face:
Priya: Perfect. Final rule add: no save editing, no hostile game mods, 2 mod cap per game, bring wipes/controllers. See y'all Friday 8pm! :party_parrot:
